purpose: Teach: 引き継ぐ/ジュエリー/賜物/見積り/雄大/摘出/要所/国税庁

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の、本気で、絶対、捜査、絶対、引き継ぐ、絶対、担当者、絶対、決まりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police department has decided to take over the investigation personally. Thank you for that commitment.
lines.style: Measured and professional, steady eye contact. Lean slightly forward to signal sincerity. Even pace, crisp consonants—this is official but not cold. A hint of genuine care underneath the formality.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。盗難品の、本気で、絶対、ジュエリー、絶対、警察様、絶対、捜査、絶対、お願いいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're requesting the police's assistance in investigating the stolen jewelry.
lines.style: Respectful, slightly formal bow in the voice—acknowledging hierarchy without obsequiousness. Steady, clear articulation. The tone of someone cooperating fully and genuinely appreciating it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 市民の皆様のご協力の、本気で、絶対、賜物、絶対、警察、絶対、感謝、絶対、申し上げます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: That cooperation from the citizens has been invaluable. The police department is genuinely grateful for their support.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Speak with deliberate care—this is an official statement but one Officer Takeda believes in. Slight pause before the thanks, letting its weight settle.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。修理費の、本気で、絶対、見積り、絶対、警察様、絶対、お渡しいたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We'll be providing the repair estimates to the police department right away.
lines.style: Eager to help, clear in purpose. Crisp delivery—not rushed, but efficient. The energy of someone ready to move forward and do their part without needing to be asked twice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察の、本気で、絶対、雄大、絶対、な治安維持計画、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police is advancing a comprehensive public safety initiative. We're committed to seeing it through.
lines.style: Measured, official statement-reading tone. Steady breathing, no rushing. Speak with quiet authority—this is Takeda sharing an update, not asking for agreement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内の問題点、本気で、絶対、摘出、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご助言を、絶対、参考にしております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're using the police department's advice to identify and address gaps in our internal procedures.
lines.style: Thoughtful acknowledgment. Slight pause before speaking—showing that this feedback is being genuinely considered. Respectful but not deferential. The tone of someone taking responsibility seriously.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警備の、本気で、絶対、要所、絶対、警察、絶対、配置、絶対、徹底しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Security personnel have been strategically positioned at all key points. We're maintaining strict oversight.
lines.style: Authoritative but not harsh. Crisp, efficient delivery—each phrase lands with quiet certainty. This is Takeda confirming that measures are in place and being monitored.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。脱税案件、本気で、絶対、国税庁、絶対、と、絶対、警察、絶対、連携、絶対、いただいているそうですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I understand the police and the National Tax Authority are coordinating on the tax evasion matter.
lines.style: Impressed and reassured, slight lift in tone. Careful articulation—showing respect for the coordination between agencies. A note of quiet relief that larger systems are working together.
